::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

This section is adapted from @zhou2024pd,
used under the MIT License
(see the license text in @sec-subspaces).
The source's eigenvalue and quadratic-form characterizations of definiteness
are covered in these notes already (@thm-definite-eigenvalues).
These parts of the source are left out:

- its covariance test, which needs probability
- its material on minimization
- its positive semidefinite version of the Schur complement test
- its pivot test
- its Hadamard-product "Schur lemma"
- its notes on the LU factorization and computational cost
- its statement that a nonnegative combination of positive semidefinite matrices is positive semidefinite
  (@thm-pd-operations states the positive definite version)
- its section on the ellipse $a x^2 + 2 b x y + c y^2 = 1$, with its worked example of a positive definite and an indefinite matrix
- its numerical example of the Cholesky factorization

The source leaves the Schur complement test unproved;
it is proved here from a block expansion of the quadratic form,
and the Cholesky factorization is derived from it.

:::
